subject.title: New session fails in custom non-Git Gateway folders

question: Should the Control UI support direct Gateway-local sessions in arbitrary non-Git folders, or should it continue to require managed worktrees for all non-default Gateway paths?
rationale: Current public documentation and the original merged feature both describe the forced-worktree behavior, while this report requests a deliberate change to that established safety and isolation boundary.

options.title: Support direct non-Git folders
options.body: Permit an explicit direct Gateway `cwd` for selected non-Git folders, retain worktrees as an opt-in Git-only isolation mode, and update tests and docs.

options.title: Keep worktrees mandatory
options.body: Preserve the current documented requirement and clarify the UI so custom non-Git folders are not presented as selectable direct-session targets.

recommendation.title: Support direct non-Git folders
recommendation.body: Permit an explicit direct Gateway `cwd` for selected non-Git folders, retain worktrees as an opt-in Git-only isolation mode, and update tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant New session and folder-browser behavior was introduced through the merged feature work associated with this person.
